```artifact
Feature: Services within Padmavathi Hospital Zone

  Scenario: Patients register for appointments within the specified zone
  Given the hospital is within a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi or specified PinCodes
  When a patient resides in the zone
  Then they should be able to register for appointments

  Scenario Outline:
    | Patient Pincode | Expected Result |
    | <valid_pincode> | Success |
    | <invalid_pincode> | Failure |
    | <edge_pincode> | Failure |

  Scenario: Authorized Chemist operations per Pincode
  Given there is one authorized chemist per Pincode
  When a chemist operates in the zone
  Then they should be able to deliver medicines and collect payments

  Scenario Outline:
    | Chemist Pincode | Expected Result |
    | <valid_pincode> | Success |
    | <invalid_pincode> | Failure |
    | <edge_pincode> | Failure |

  Scenario: Prescription routing to chemist
  Given a prescription request matches patient Pincode to chemist Pincode
  When a prescription is routed
  Then it should be delivered to the correct chemist

  Scenario Outline:
    | Patient Pincode | Chemist Pincode | Expected Result |
    | <valid_pincode> | <valid_pincode> | Success |
    | <invalid_pincode> | <valid_pincode> | Failure |
    | <valid_pincode> | <invalid_pincode> | Failure |

  Scenario: Chemist delivery and marking prescription
  Given a chemist delivers medicines
  When they mark the prescription
  Then the prescription should be marked

  Scenario: Laboratory operations per Pincode
  Given there is one authorized laboratory per Pincode or for the entire zone
  When a laboratory operates
  Then they should be able to conduct tests

  Scenario Outline:
    | Laboratory Pincode | Expected Result |
    | <valid_pincode> | Success |
    | <invalid_pincode> | Failure |
    | <edge_pincode> | Failure |

```
